_meta.description: Facet of region on the converters of experiment.pulse (FILTER_INCLUDE converted yes) decorated with an OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_POP group overlay: each region's subset frequency against its population frequency, (subset_freq - pop_freq) / sd_pop, sd_pop the population SD across the per-region frequencies (north about +11, west about -15 here). Pair it with OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_POP (10_facet_index_vs_pop.json) for two series layers from one facet pass. ref.population.cohort names the comparison cohort, resolved as the host cohort is (under its data_dir). Streamable. A zero population frequency emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO and skips the entry; renderers centre colour ramps on baseline 0.
_meta.name: facet-zscore-vs-pop
